darwin22_overlay.scope: Spell out IODeleteData allocation-size and pointer-erasure operations to avoid the Darwin 22 typed-pointer builtin on dependent template types; heap and bounds are unchanged.

board_firmware_overlay.scope: Optional board-owned firmware pin table; standalone reference tests retain their original defaults.

board_inputs.scope: DT declarations and explicit allocation policy. Live SoC/SKU/fuse, ACTLR readback, power, thermal calibration and GPU execution require runtime validation.

scope: Standalone source archive with Gen8 orchestration, GMU/HFI, SMMU, CP, fences, recovery and DCVS, plus the exact iPhone accelerator base. The board variant adds CPH2653 declarations, firmware pins and an explicit synchronous entry. Metal protocol extensions and complete lifecycle/prelink integration remain separate.
